priority.purpose: Measure adaptive-control value on the CatBoost-beating deep single tree.

priority.name: epicycle_model_selection
priority.purpose: Test whether ordinary unknown-problem generic regularization deforms an overparameterized high-order epicycle warm start toward lower effective complexity and held-out arc/new-orbit transfer.
primary_regularization: identical shared generic regularization entrypoint/configuration to ordinary unknown-problem runs
primary_forbidden: Fourier frequency or epicycle order penalty
arms: no-regularization epicycle warm start, including zero optimizer weight decay
SECONDARY domain-specific Fourier-energy/order penalty positive control
priority.secondary_positive_control: RETAINED; explicitly domain-informed, never mixed into primary discovery evidence
endpoints: contribution-based participation and entropy effective tree counts
priority.double_descent: Require an interpolation-associated generalization peak followed by a second improvement; report switched-objective continuation explicitly, retain failures; no claim from complexity decline alone
